tasks.label: deploy
tasks.command: npm rebuild better-sqlite3 && npm run generate && git add . && MSG=$(claude -p --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions "Generate a concise conventional commit message for the staged changes. Output only the message on a single line, no quotes, no code blocks." 2>/dev/null || copilot -p --allow-all "Generate a concise conventional commit message for the staged changes. Output only the message on a single line, no quotes, no code blocks." 2>/dev/null || echo "deploy: regenerate static site") && git commit -m "$MSG" && git push

tasks.label: run
tasks.command: npm rebuild better-sqlite3 && npm run dev
